subtests.name: RTCAudioSourceStats audioLevel reflects the audio level of the source

RTCAudioSourceStats totalAudioEnergy and totalSamplesDuration accumulate after a disabled track is enabled

RTCAudioSourceStats totalSamplesDuration and totalAudioEnergy on a new track do not inherit the accumulated value from the previously attached track
RTCAudioSourceStats totalAudioEnergy reflects the energy of the source
RTCAudioSourceStats totalSamplesDuration and totalAudioEnergy accumulation are not effected by being attached to multiple senders
RTCAudioSourceStats id not inherited when the track is replaced with a new track
